source: ONS monthly PSF bulletin cumulative borrowing chart CSV
vintage: Parsed from download notes; March 2026 in initial fixture
releaseDate: ONS republication date, parsed from bulletin; original forecast and profile publication dates are distinct
transformations: Select explicitly labelled OBR forecast column
Retain cumulative figures as published, no interpolation
compatibility: Compare only with ONS public-sector net borrowing excluding public-sector banks for the same financial year. £0.1bn source rounding applies.
failure: Reject changed units, missing vintage, ambiguous chart, malformed year, incomplete profile or non-finite values. Keep last verified payload; report refresh failure.
validation: Real ONS July 2026 bulletin fixture: April 20.9, July 54.4 and March 115.4 billion; fiscal-year rollover and seasonal surplus preserved.
licence: ONS Open Government Licence applies to republication; retain ONS/OBR attribution.
